digest.component_or_area: gate rubric and plan review scoring
propositions: Two regex-based code paths and one scope extractor currently key on the '## Success Criteria' heading; this heading must be retired and all references pointed to '## Acceptance Criteria' instead
Repointing the clarity-score epic branch bonus from Success Criteria to Acceptance Criteria keeps the score neutral (6 points) and avoids a live regression across 108 migrated tickets

All test fixtures embedding '## Success Criteria' in ticket descriptions must be migrated: fixtures with both headings drop the SC block; fixtures with only SC rename it to '## Acceptance Criteria' and convert bullets to checkbox format
The two _clarity_score implementations in gates.py and det_floor.py must remain textually in lockstep with identical epic-branch logic and diffing verification
A new contract test must assert that an epic carrying '## Acceptance Criteria' and '## Context' passes both clarity-check and check-ac with _clarity_score equaling 6
No fixture corpus under the specified test paths shall carry '## Success Criteria' as live plan vocabulary, except within the new negative-case test that proves the heading is inert
